rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for the outside of an object or package.

example.english: The exterior of the package is completely dirty.
example.jyutping: go3 baau1 zong1 ngoi6 min6 wu1 zou1 saai3

rows.note: Use this when you mean the object's visible or physical outer surface specifically.

example.english: The exterior of the table has lots of scratches.
example.jyutping: zoeng1 ci4 biu2 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 gwaat3 han4

rows.note: Use this for a protective outer casing or shell rather than just any outside surface.

example.english: The exterior of the phone is cracked.
example.jyutping: bou6 din6 waa2 ngoi6 hok3 lit6 zo2
